exposure: Exposures during the first 1000 days of life
cohort: The study included 14,740 preschool children representative of three socioeconomic areas of Hanoi, Vietnam.
finding: Gestational weight gain >20 kg, birth weight >4000 grams, meal duration <20 min, preference for fatty foods, and bedtime snack were significantly and positively associated with both overweight and obesity.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was significantly associated with overweight (OW), but not with obesity (OB).
cross-section timing: Data was collected among preschool children, examining factors during the first 1000 days of life.
